units.source_text: 然后他告诉我，他叫荣吉，妻子叫千代子，妹妹叫薰子。

en.t: Then he told me that his name was Eikichi, his wife was Chiyoko, and his younger sister was Kaoruko.

units.source_text: 另一个姑娘叫百合子，十七岁，唯独她是大岛人，雇来的。

en.t: The other girl was named Yuriko and was seventeen; she alone was from Oshima and had been hired.

units.source_text: 荣吉非常伤感，老是哭丧着脸，凝望着河滩。

en.t: Eikichi was deeply melancholy, always wearing a sorrowful face as he gazed at the riverbank.
